command: python3 evaluate.py inspect CASE ACTUAL_RECEIPT NEW_RESULT
case_selection: CASE is a key from expectations.json; it is chosen independently of the producer receipt.
weighted_vertex: (1-w)*positions[i] + w*positions[j]; boundary t uses the same weights on the owning curve.
checks: Exact authoritative source fields, ordering, IDs, allocator, revision and f64 bits; v1/v2 migrate only the specified version-dependent fields and empty group vector.
Independent cumulative authored arc lengths within 1e-8 m per path.
Derived portions preserve list order and interval direction, cover the full path, and split at every A/B/map knot; harmless extra subdivisions are allowed.
Both one-sided physical endpoints at disconnected knots survive; stored selected endpoint t values remain exact.
Every mesh stitch belongs to its original curve; weights never create an artificial connector across disconnected spans.
Infer continuous cumulative lengths independently from boundary t and weights, then check authored group correspondence; legacy seams retain normalized parameter correspondence.
Every required cell endpoint and relevant selected mesh boundary sample has a real stitch with the group ID.
Mesh revision matches source. Weighted rest chord deviation is reported separately and never substitutes for the authored answer.
